zh.title: 浏览款式并选择喜欢的设计
zh.description: 在我们的款式展示中浏览各种精美的美甲设计，找到您喜欢的款式并记录下对应的编号。
zh.tips:
您可以根据形状、风格进行筛选
注意：由于纯手工制作，实际效果可能与展示效果有细微差异

zh.title: 通过社交媒体联系我们
zh.description: 通过TikTok或WhatsApp联系我们的客服，告知您选择的款式编号和收货地址。

zh.title: 确认订单并完成支付
zh.description: 我们会与您确认订单详情，包括款式、价格和配送信息。确认后请完成支付流程。
zh.tips: 支持多种支付方式，支付成功后将发送订单确认

zh.title: 制作完成并安排发货
zh.description: 我们会在约定时间内完成美甲制作，并通过国际快递发送给您，同时提供物流追踪信息。
zh.tips: 一般8-15个工作日送达，请耐心等待

en.title: Browse designs and choose your favorite
en.description: Browse through our collection of exquisite nail designs, find your favorite and note down the corresponding ID.
en.tips:
You can filter by shape and style
Note: Due to the manual nature of the production process, the actual effect may differ slightly from the displayed effect.

en.title: Contact us via social media
en.description: Contact our customer service via TikTok or WhatsApp, inform us of your chosen design ID and delivery address.

en.title: Confirm order and complete payment
en.description: We will confirm your order details, including design, price and delivery information. Please complete the payment process after confirmation.
en.tips: Multiple payment methods are supported, and an order confirmation will be sent after successful payment

en.title: Production complete and shipping arranged
en.description: We will complete the production process within the agreed time and send it to you by international express, with logistics tracking information provided.
en.tips: It will generally be delivered within 8 to 15 working days. Please be patient.
